Other Events Termination of Jefferies Sales Agreement As previously disclosed, on July 1, 2022, Monte Rosa Therapeutics, Inc. (the “ Company ”) entered into an Open Market Sale Agreement SM (the “ Original Jefferies Sales Agreement ”) with Jefferies LLC (“ Jefferies ”), and on March 20, 2025, entered into Amendment No. 1 to the Original Jefferies Sales Agreement (the “ Jefferies Amendment ”, and, together with the Original Jefferies Sales Agreement, the “ Jefferies Sales Agreement ”), pursuant to which the Company could offer and sell shares of its common stock, par value $0.0001 per share (the “ Common Stock ”), from time to time through Jefferies, acting as the sales agent. On November 23, 2026, the Company delivered written notice to Jefferies to terminate the Jefferies Sales Agreement pursuant to Section 7(b)(i) thereof, effective as of November 25, 2026. The Company is not subject to any termination penalties related to the termination of the Jefferies Sales Agreement. Pursuant to the Jefferies Sales Agreement, the Company sold an aggregate of 2,955,082 shares of Common Stock for aggregate net proceeds of approximately $23.9 million, all of which were sold pursuant to the prospectus supplement dated March 20, 2025, filed under the Company’s registration statement on Form S-3 (File No. 333-285942) (the “ Original Prospectus Supplement ”), prior to the termination of the Original Prospectus Supplement effective January 7, 2026. No shares of Common Stock were sold under the prospectus supplement filed on February 11, 2026, in connection with the Company’s registration statement on Form S-3ASR (File No. 333-293389). As a result of the termination of the Jefferies Sales Agreement, the Company will not offer or sell any additional shares of Common Stock under the Jefferies Sales Agreement. Copies of the Original Jefferies Sales Agreement and the Jefferies Amendment were filed as Exhibit 1.2 and Exhibit 1.3, respectively, to the Company’s shelf registration statement on Form S-3ASR (File No. 333-293389) filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “ Commission ”) on February 11, 2026, which became automatically effective upon filing (the “ Registration Statement ”). The description of the Jefferies Sales Agreement contained in this Current Report on Form 8-K does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the copies of the Original Jefferies Sales Agreement and the Jefferies Amendment filed as Exhibit 1.2 and Exhibit 1.3 to the Registration Statement, respectively. Entry into the TD Cowen Sales Agreement On November 25, 2026, the Company entered into a Sales Agreement (the “ Sales Agreement ”) with TD Securities (USA) LLC (“ TD Cowen ”) to sell shares of Common Stock from time to time (the “ Placement Shares ”) through or to TD Cowen, acting as sales agent or principal, in an “at the market” equity offering program. Sales of the Placement Shares, if any, may be made by any method permitted by law, including, without limitation, sales deemed to be an “at the market offering” as defined in Rule 415 under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “ Securities Act ”), sales made by means of ordinary brokers’ transactions, sales made to or through a market maker at market prices prevailing at the time of sale, at prices related to the prevailing market prices or at negotiated prices, and privately negotiated transactions, including block trades. Sales under the Sales Agreement may be made through an affiliate of TD Cowen. Under the Sales Agreement, the Company will set the parameters for the sale of the Placement Shares, including the number of Placement Shares to be issued, the time period during which sales are requested to be made, limitations on the number of Placement Shares that may be sold in any one trading day and any minimum price below which sales may not be made. The Company is not obligated to sell any Placement Shares under the Sales Agreement, and neither the Company nor TD Cowen will have any obligation with respect to a sale unless and until the Company delivers a placement notice and TD Cowen does not decline it. The Company or TD Cowen may suspend sales of Placement Shares upon notice to the other party. The Company will pay TD Cowen a commission of up to 3.0% of the gross proceeds from the sale of any Placement Shares under the Sales Agreement, and has agreed to reimburse TD Cowen for certain specified expenses, including fees and disbursements of its counsel. The Company has also agreed to provide TD Cowen with customary indemnification and contribution rights against certain liabilities, including liabilities under the Securities Act and the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. The Sales Agreement may be terminated by the Company or TD Cowen in its sole discretion at any time upon ten days’ prior written notice to the other party, and by TD Cowen at any time upon notice in certain other circumstances specified in the Sales Agreement. The Placement Shares will be issued pursuant to the Registration Statement, or one or more additional registration statements the Company may file with the Commission from time to time, as such registration statements become effective. The Company filed a prospectus supplement, dated November 25, 2026, with the Commission in connection with the offer and sale of the Placement Shares pursuant to the Sales Agreement. The foregoing description of the material terms of the Sales Agreement is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full agreement, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 1.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference. Goodwin Procter LLP, counsel to the Company, has issued an opinion to the Company, dated November 25, 2026, regarding the validity of the Placement Shares to be issued and sold pursuant to the Sales Agreement. A copy of the opinion is filed as Exhibit 5.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. This Current Report on Form 8-K shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of any offer to buy the securities discussed herein, nor shall there be any offer, solicitation or sale of the securities in any state in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any such state.
